episodes.title: Everything's Bright, Am I Aging?
episodes.summary: On a Dec 25 without Christmas, Sanda is attacked by classmate Shiori. Mistaking it for love, he awaits her confession, but hears something else.

episodes.title: Candies, Canes, Kisses, and Blades
episodes.summary: Amaya learns Sanda is Santa, restrains him and Shiori to force a kiss. Santa refuses, unlocks sled power to escape. Then Headmaster Oshibu appears!

episodes.title: Charred Fruit Tastes All the Sweeter
episodes.summary: Sanda gains lie-detecting power. Shiori tries to use it to find Ono, but doubt overwhelms Sanda. Shiori then tells a self-harming lie.

episodes.title: Zeus, Smasher of Textbooks
episodes.summary: At a funeral, Santa fights Yagiuda but fears his power. His resolve returns, shattering the roof and leaving him exposed before all.

episodes.title: A Typhoon in a Snow Globe
episodes.summary: Sanda vows never to love, but in a typhoon his message to fiancee Niko fails and he's drawn to her. The next day, Yagiuda arrives as a teacher.

episodes.title: Cyborg vs. Santa Claus
episodes.summary: Santa blocks Headmaster Oshibu from attacking adult Ono, but the enhanced 92-year-old overpowers him. Santa asks the kids for their belief to fight.

episodes.title: Double-Faced Carnivorous Plant
episodes.summary: Amaya ends his friendship with Sanda to save him. Meanwhile, the scarred Oshibu, comforted by Yagiuda, turns to Class 10 students who killed adults.

episodes.title: Love, the Most Selfish Thing There Is
episodes.summary: Saved from Namatame by Shiori, Santa vows to harden his heart, but when Niko asks for a kiss, Sanda panics and almost transforms before her.

episodes.title: A Fake Flower, Yet Its Roots Rot
episodes.summary: Tetsudome says Santa lacks grit. With her aid Sanda becomes dark Santa, but doubts himself. After meeting Namatame again, he vows not to fight kids.

episodes.title: You, an Everlasting Moment
episodes.summary: At the Peak of Youth Ceremony, Niko steals Sanda's first kiss at twilight. Meanwhile Yagiuda faces Namatame alone, offering himself as decoy.

episodes.title: Flashback Attack
episodes.summary: Namatame wrecks the ceremony. Eating yakisoba, she's met by Sanda in child form. His body starts breaking down as Ono's own changes grow.

episodes.title: Pale Blue Pall
episodes.summary: Santa fights Oshibu before the students. The headmaster thrives on cheers, but Santa regains power by revealing his truth. The duel peaks on the roof.
